These checks are **planned, not run**. MuMuPlayer is primary; use explicit ADB serials and known build/density/refresh rate. Web results supplement, never replace, native evidence.

After warm-up, repeat ten transitions on the same fixture/build; retain recordings and available JS/UI profiler/frame data. Target at least 95% within the device frame budget and no repeatable stall over 50 ms attributable to the change.
